title: Common Infinitesimal Generator Protocol for Γ_R and ρ_P
problem_from_V1689_13: Event-action rho_P is structurally clean and normalized, but its orientation is mostly perpendicular to D_Gamma R_Gamma.
core_correction: Γ_R transport and provenance current representation must be induced by the same generated-algebra infinitesimal generator A_pq.

central_object.event_relation: rho_e must be a component/projection of the same generator algebra as A_pq
central_object.curvature_relation: R_Gamma loop curvature is produced by noncommuting composition of A_pq around loops

A_pq_must_satisfy: derivation-like product rule: A(x op_plus y) ≈ A(x) op_plus y + x op_plus A(y) + source/provenance correction
associator covariance: A(A3_p) matches induced change in O3 across p->q
H4 covariance: A(H4_perp_p) matches induced change in H4_perp across p->q
source/provenance coupling: source/order events map into the same generator space
order-arrow admissibility: A_pq may be directed and non-invertible

curvature_from_generator.edge_transport: T_pq = Exp_R(A_pq), where Exp_R may be directed/truncated/admissible rather than reversible matrix exponential
curvature_from_generator.small_loop_approx: R_Gamma(C) ≈ Σ_edges A_e + Σ_commutators [A_e,A_f] + higher retained terms
curvature_from_generator.noncommutativity: curvature arises from failure of generated-algebra derivations to commute around retained loops
curvature_from_generator.directed_warning: do not require A_qp = -A_pq unless reversible transport is independently admissible

rho_from_generator.event_action: For event e on boundary B_ij, rho_e = projection of A_pq onto the event-affected generated-algebra component.
rho_from_generator.formula: rho_e = P_event(e) A_pq P_event(e) or signed incidence component of A_pq
rho_from_generator.orientation_rule: rho_e orientation must come from A_pq, not standalone projectors.

identity.meaning: source/provenance current is the generator-induced boundary term of curvature compatibility.

killer_nulls.N_generator_shuffle: preserve A_pq norms and scalar transport statistics but shuffle generator component orientations across edges.
killer_nulls.N_event_projection_shuffle: preserve event counts/magnitudes and A_pq, but attach events to wrong generator components.
killer_nulls.N_commutator_flatten: preserve edge A norms but force commuting generators; should reduce/alter curvature while preserving scalar magnitudes.
killer_nulls.N_reverse_generator: reverse directed generator orientation; should fail order/provenance compatibility.

failure_conditions: rho_e still built from standalone projectors
A_pq computed from E_Gamma or fitted residual
T_pq and rho_P use different generator spaces
source-free closure used before source-balanced closure
next_execution: V1689.15 should emit A_pq generators first, derive T_pq and rho_e from A_pq, then rerun structural audit with generator-level nulls.
claim_boundary: Derivation protocol only. No validation or law claim.
